about_the_game:
Backed by psychology, built for fun.
Connect Quest is the first roguelite built with a psychologist to help couples grow closer — one run, one laugh, and one breakthrough at a time.

Whether you’ve been together for months or decades, Connect Quest turns connection into a co-op adventure. Each run brings new, randomly selected prompts, challenges, and playful moments — no two journeys are ever the same.

How It Works

  • Choose Your Path – Each “quest” is a short session packed with thought-provoking questions, fun challenges, and shared discoveries.

  • Unlock New Content – Earn points and unlock deeper question sets, playful twists, and unique connection “artifacts” that change your runs.

  • Built for All Couples – Lighthearted or deep, playful or reflective — you decide the tone each time you play.

  • Science Meets Play – Developed with input from a licensed psychologist, the prompts are grounded in relationship research and attachment theory.

Why Play?

  • Break the Routine – Swap endless scrolling for something you’ll both remember.

  • Learn Something New – Even about someone you thought you knew completely.

  • Make It Yours – From cozy nights in to date night adventures, tailor your session to your mood.

    Key Features

    • Roguelite progression keeps every run fresh and replayable.

    • Conversation prompts and mini-challenges based on proven psychology.

    • Unlockable categories that go from playful to deeply meaningful.

    • Easy drop-in play — perfect for 15-minute bursts or longer sessions.

    • Made for all couples — dating, married, long-distance, or rekindling.

      Your relationship is the adventure.
      Ready to level up your love?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs on low-spec hardware — if your PC can run basic indie games, it can run Connect Quest.
